title: Build a Virtualized List with react-window (Fixed Size)
description: Build a high-performance virtualized list that renders only visible rows using windowing (react-window / react-virtuoso) for 100k+ items.

title: Build a Variable-Size Virtualized Feed (Dynamic Heights)
description: Extend virtualization to items with unknown/variable heights (e.g. social feed with images & text) — measure and cache heights.

title: Build a File Explorer with Nested Drag-and-Drop
description: Build a VS Code-style file explorer tree with folders/files, expand/collapse, and nested drag-and-drop reordering.

title: Build a File Explorer Toolbar — Breadcrumbs, Search & Context Menu
description: Extend the file explorer with breadcrumbs, live search filtering, and a right-click context menu.

title: Build a Collaborative Kanban Board with Yjs (CRDT)
description: Build a Trello-like Kanban board with drag-and-drop columns/cards and real-time collaboration via Yjs.

title: Build a Kanban Board with Swimlanes & WIP Limits
description: Build a Kanban board variant with swimlanes (by assignee/priority) and WIP limit enforcement per column.

title: Build a Command Palette (kbar / cmdk) with Fuzzy Search
description: Build a Spotlight-style command palette (⌘K) with fuzzy search, groups, and keyboard navigation — trending via kbar & cmdk.

title: Build Resizable Panels with useResizable Hook
description: Build a resizable split layout where a draggable handle adjusts two panels — implement a reusable useResizable hook.

title: Build an Image Carousel with Infinite Loop & Swipe
description: Build a carousel with next/prev arrows, dots, infinite looping, autoplay (pause on hover), and touch swipe.

title: Build a Todo App with Pagination, Filters & Optimistic Updates
description: Build a todo list with server-like pagination (5 per page), filters, and optimistic CRUD.

title: Build Infinite Scroll with IntersectionObserver & Skeleton
description: Build a feed that loads next pages as the user scrolls, using IntersectionObserver with skeletons and deduped fetches.

title: Build Autocomplete / Typeahead with Debounce & Highlight
description: Build a typeahead input that fetches suggestions debounced, highlights matches, and supports full keyboard navigation.

title: Build an Accessible Modal with Focus Trap & Scroll Lock
description: Build a modal dialog with overlay, focus trap, Esc/outside-click close, body scroll lock, and focus restore.

title: Build a Poll Widget with Live Results & Confetti
description: Build a poll widget where users vote once, see animated percentage bars, and share results.

title: Build a Split Pane (Horizontal & Vertical) with Constraints
description: Build a split pane that can split horizontally or vertically, with draggable gutter, collapsible panes, and keyboard support.

title: Build a Data Table with Virtualized Rows, Sorting & Filtering
description: Build a spreadsheet-like data table with column sorting, filters, sticky header, and virtualized rows for 50k rows.

title: Build Nested Comments with Collapsible Threads & Voting
description: Build a Reddit-style nested comments system with infinite nesting, collapse, voting, and optimistic replies.

title: Build a Tabs Component with URL Sync & Lazy Mounting
description: Build an accessible tabs component that syncs active tab to URL, supports lazy mounting, and keyboard roving.

title: Build a Toast / Snackbar Queue with Pause on Hover
description: Build a toast notification system with queue, auto-dismiss, pause on hover, and stacking with limits.

title: Build a Date Picker Calendar with Range Selection
description: Build a calendar date picker supporting single date and range selection, with keyboard navigation and localization.
